transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Um... well, I guess I'm here because of some... family things. Mostly my husband's sister. 

She's just... she's been working this family business, trying to get control of the money. She wants to push me out of the decisions. Folks keep trying to smooth it over, but... I know what I've been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now.
Have you noticed any changes in your senses, such as hearing voices that others don't seem to hear, or seeing things that aren't actually there?
No. I don't... I don't hear voices or anything like that. Nothing like that is going on.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications, or have you had any recent changes in your physical health?
No... I don't take any pills. And my health is fine. I'm fine.
Have you ever discussed these concerns about your sister-in-law with anyone else, and if so, what did they say?
Um... I don't really talk about it much. Just... like I said, folks just try to smooth it over. They don't want to get in the middle of it, I guess. So I mostly just... keep it to myself.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your sister-in-law might not actually be trying to push you out of the business, or are you certain that she is?

I... I know what I'm seeing. I didn't just make this up. I came here because... well, she's been working the family business just so she can get control of the money. She wants to push me out of the decisions. And... I know what I've been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now. People can try to smooth it over all they want, but... I'm certain. I know what she's doing.
Has this situation with your sister-in-law caused you to miss work, stop seeing friends, or struggle with your daily household responsibilities?

No, I... I haven't stopped doing my regular things. I still go to my quilting group and... choir practice. And my GED lessons and the senior walks. I still do all that just like always. It's just... well, it mostly just changes how much I trust her. And... maybe which family things I go to now. That's all.
Have any of your family members or close friends ever explicitly told you that they think your suspicions about your sister-in-law are not true?
Um... no. Not to my face, anyway. They mostly just... well, they just change the subject. I don't really ask them about it, so... nobody really says much of anything.
Are there any other people or situations in your life that you feel suspicious or uncertain about, besides your sister-in-law?
No. Just her. I don't... I don't have any reason to think anyone else is doing anything. It's just what I already told you.
Do you feel that your sister-in-law is working with anyone else, or is she acting entirely on her own?
No... I don't think so. Just her. I haven't seen anyone else involved.
Do you ever find that your thoughts feel jumbled, or that you have trouble keeping track of what you are thinking about?
No... I don't think so. My mind works fine. I know what I'm thinking about.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being broadcast to others, or that someone is putting thoughts into your head that aren't yours?
No... I don't know what you mean by that. They're just my own thoughts. Nobody is doing that.
Do you feel that your sister-in-law's actions are motivated solely by money, or do you believe she has any intentions to physically harm you or cause you some other kind of trouble?
I... I think it's just the money. She hasn't tried to hurt me or anything like that. She just... wants what's mine.
